references.text: Describes women who followed Jesus from Galilee to serve him and were present at the crucifixion, including Mary Magdalene and other women.
Mentions all his acquaintances standing at a distance, including the women who had followed him from Galilee and observed these events.
Mentions women near the cross, including Jesus' mother, her sister's son, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
